final:
parity(x: u8) -> bool =
  ex parity(0) == False
  ex parity(1) == True
  ex parity(3) == False
  ex parity(7) == True
  ex parity(255) == False
  var v = x
  v = v ^ (v >> 4)
  v = v ^ (v >> 2)
  v = v ^ (v >> 1)
  (v & 1) == 1
